issue_request: FHIR-17629 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction raised against STU3 and auto-approved. In converted git history, f5f3c82db3 (GF#17629 - fix typos, git-svn build@14533) applied the labeled changes to source/extensibility.html, source/history.html, and the historical source/careplan/careplan-spreadsheet.xml. The adjacent same-day commit f25a484e20 corrected source/http.html from 412 Conflict to 412 Precondition Failed and changed source/json.html away from saying both given and family repeat; later commit 6940f50152/FHIR-18447 cleaned that JSON wording further.
additional_context: The old CarePlan spreadsheet source has been replaced by current CarePlan XML sources. CarePlan is active in source/fhir.ini, and the current search parameter bundle uses plannedActivityReference rather than timingSchedule. Later HTTP and JSON work preserved the corrections relevant to this issue. Jira SQL for the exact typo terms returned only FHIR-17629, and Zulip/Confluence searches found no relevant discussion or minutes changing the source-history conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/extensibility.html nests the fake passport-number extension inside the citizenship extension and has aligned JSON, source/history.html links the STU3 milestone to STU3, source/json.html says only given repeats and treats _family separately, source/http.html uses 412 Precondition Failed, and source/careplan/bundle-CarePlan-search-params.xml uses the current CarePlan activity reference path.
